findings.title: Note: live dev-server verification not evidenced
findings.evidence: manifest.json entry for 'Dev server on a free port with D_SYSTEM_DEMO_TERMINAL unset...' is ran:false, 'not run: not a command'. Acceptance is supported by stubbed-fetch vitest tests (95/95 pass) and by vite.config.ts:264 setting the header on every 200 response.
findings.consequence: The behaviour against the real Vite fallback with the flag unset is inferred, not observed.
findings.minimal_fix: Owner or coordinator runs the stated live check once (flag unset, then set) and records the result.

findings.title: Note: second pytest failure, test_control_characters_reach_the_shell, in the gate run
findings.evidence: 07-gate.txt: FAILED test/test_demo_terminal_api.py::test_control_characters_reach_the_shell, "'after-ctrl-c-4' never appeared" with ^C echoed in the pty. Diff touches only ts/src/stage files.
findings.consequence: A gate pytest failure unrelated to the diff; likely environmental (root shell and pty signal handling). Not caused by this phase.
findings.minimal_fix: Confirm it also fails on the base commit in the same environment; if so, treat it like idea 000604.
